text.tspan: 1. Everything grey is DNP (not fitted). Fit it only on units that need it. R30 is always fitted: it keeps IO4 low (RS485 = receive).
2. UART1_RX can have only one driver: fit EITHER U10 (RS485) OR a module on J9, never both.
3. Close JP2 (120 R termination) only on the two units at the physical ends of the RS485 cable.
